First release of **Dream Displays Lumen**, an addon for [Dream Displays](https://modrinth.com/mod/dreamdisplays): displays light up the room in the colors of their video, like a real screen or cinema canvas, with and without shaders.

### Features
- **Colored light per area of the picture:** each video frame is reduced to a grid of zone colors (4 × 3 by default); the left part of the picture lights the left part of the room.
- **Light like a real canvas:** distance and angle falloff, shadows from blocks, smooth fade at the end of the range (20 blocks by default).
- **Follows every video frame**; a soft static glow while Dream Displays shows its loading screen.
- **Shaders (Iris):** the light is added after the shader pack's final pass, depth-tested against the scene. Tested with Complementary and Solas (TAA packs included).
- **LambDynamicLights (optional):** while a shader pack is active, the display also raises the block light in front of it.
- **Settings in Dream Displays' display menu:** *Room light* and *Light color* per display (0–200 %).
- **Commands:** `/ddlumen status | reload | toggle | intensity <0–16> | saturation <0–4> | blocklight <shaders|always|off>`.
- English and German.

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API
- Dream Displays 1.10.6+ (client)
- Optional: Sodium + Iris, LambDynamicLights (1.20.1 and newer)

Client-only: servers only need Dream Displays itself.

### Version notes
- Before 1.21.11 the colored light is off while a shader pack is active (LambDynamicLights block light still works on 1.20.1 and 1.21.1).
- Before 1.20 there is no LambDynamicLights support.

### Known Dream Displays issues (not caused by Lumen)
With Dream Displays 1.10.6, the video quality can switch between 720p and 1080p every few seconds at some distances. That causes frame jumps, and a black screen for about 45 s after the video ends. Workaround: set the display's quality to 720p, or start the game with `-Ddreamdisplays.lod.size=false`.
